The tax-collector's boast 'I tithe all I acquire' (Luke 18:12) illustrates self-righteous precision. In Hebrews 7:5, the Levitical priests collect tithes from the people. Spanish 'diezmar/diezmo' and French 'donner la dîme' preserve the explicit tenth-part etymology that English 'tithe' also carries."

Jesus's sharp critique in Matthew 23:23 and Luke 11:42 targets those who tithe garden herbs with meticulous care but neglect weightier matters of the law...
